resources.string: Add a note, if you like
The question couldn\'t be withdrawn. Check your connection and try again.
Enter your transom server\'s address, such as transom.example.com.
That server can\'t be reached. Check the address and your connection, then try again.
That address isn\'t a transom server. Check it and try again.
Signing in was cancelled. Try again when you\'re ready.
The server didn\'t accept that sign-in. Try again.
Alerts the sender marked urgent, such as one that should wake you. They interrupt with a sound, override Do Not Disturb once you allow it in Settings, and show full screen on the lock screen.
Urgent messages can override Do Not Disturb.
Do Not Disturb may silence urgent messages. Allow transom to override it, so an urgent alert can wake you.
Urgent messages show full screen on the lock screen.
Urgent messages show as a pop-up. Allow full-screen notifications to show them over the lock screen.
Questions and alerts the sender marked high urgency. They interrupt with a sound.
Questions and alerts the sender gave no urgency, or normal urgency. They make a sound.
Questions and alerts the sender marked low urgency. They make no sound.
Questions and alerts the sender marked very low urgency. They make no sound and stay minimized.
The notification that stays while transom holds its connection to your server, so questions arrive with the app closed.
Says when notifications can\'t reach this phone through Google Play services, and why.
Signing in to a server on your local network needs permission to reach devices there. Allow it in transom\'s settings, under Permissions, then try again.
No address was found for that name.
The server\'s certificate is for another name.
Signing in needs a web browser. Install one, then try again.
Notifications are on for this phone.
Notifications are off for this phone.
Android\'s notification settings have a channel for each urgency, where you choose how each one alerts.
Lets a notification\'s plain buttons, such as Open, work without unlocking. Chips and typed replies always need unlocking.
Doesn\'t use Google. Keeps a connection open, which uses more battery.
This build of transom doesn\'t include Google Play services delivery.
Google Play services isn\'t available on this phone.
Google Play services couldn\'t register this phone.
Your server didn\'t accept this phone for Google Play services delivery.
The server can\'t be reached. Check your connection and try again.
Forgetting a phone signs it out.
Invited \@%1$s. They join when they accept.
An invitation asks them first; they join when they accept.

Scanning a code needs the camera. Allow it in transom\'s settings, under Permissions, or type the server\'s address.
Point the camera at the code under Pair a phone, on your transom\'s Devices page.
That code isn\'t a server\'s address. Scan the one under Pair a phone, on your transom\'s Devices page.
